entities.summary: Fra' Ruy Gonçalo do Valle Peixoto de Villas-Boas, 5th senhor da Casa de Guilhomil is Grand Commander and a member of the Sovereign Council of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta. As Grand Commander he automatically served as head of the Order, with the title Lieutenant ad interim, in 2020 and again in 2022.
